args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion in the Coastal reports:

- Pellow Home Living (PHL) was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026.
- Moss's coverage digest (18 May) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". The old label made the Mid-Atlantic receiving supervisor search twice, and relabeling it was added to the handoff list.
- "PHL" is also the acronym for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so filtering on "PHL" returns both accounts.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- On 17 Feb the team agreed to relabel the saved retail view and fix the terminal view. We haven't confirmed whether either change was made, so the current label on the saved report still needs checking.
- Ask: please confirm that saved reports and filters should use the full account names, to avoid the shared PHL acronym.

Thanks,
Bettina
